for: BioRadar series_sync (measurement_inbox, link_version) - the Radar batch after the hardening branch merges

feed.ordering: seq strictly increasing in commit order for one is_demo; gaps are allowed; an event is never changed
feed.cursor: next_after is the last seq examined, withheld events included: advance the consumer cursor to it only after every item of the page is stored (inbox written)
feed.withheld: per source, events whose source or cause source is not readable now; after a re-grant re-read those versions with GET /measurements?version_ids= (the feed does not replay them)

pull.use: link_version(v) after triage puts v into a topic: pull v's current objects, write them to the inbox (idempotent by workspace, is_demo, measurement_id), link

linkage_expectation.rule: both orders end with the same (topic, measurement_id) links, each once; replaying the feed from 0 or pulling again adds nothing
linkage_expectation.series_key: (topic, family, dims_key, object_key): object_key is identity.key only when identity.state is confirmed or rule_confirmed; a provisional key is record-local and never merges two records
